article: Week1 Rank18 - appreciation happy men's day quotes
workflow: Higgsfield MCP nano_banana_pro with CDN product reference medias.
notes: Tetyana Gold Chain: classic solid gold link chain. Jasper Band For Him: sleek textured gold band ring. Volara Bracelet For Him: masculine modern link bracelet.

magnific.theme_anchor: High-end commercial jewellery photography, hyper-realistic, HD quality, no distortion of jewellery, identical scale and design, macro-level detail, physically accurate details, natural textures only, no stylization, no illustration. Soft natural window light, warm daylight color temperature, realistic soft shadows, proper shallow depth of field. Shot on high-end DSLR, cinematic realism, 4K resolution, widescreen 16:9 landscape with full frame composition and safe margins. Entire subjects and jewellery fully visible, nothing cropped at frame edges.
magnific.negative_prompt: illustration, CGI look, cartoon, fantasy style, over-stylized, plastic glass, fake diamonds, fake gemstones, artificial lighting, studio HDR glow, unreal reflections, blurry jewellery, noise, low detail, AI artifacts, painting, digital art, unreal scale, oversized jewellery, distorted hands, extra fingers, extra bracelets, extra rings, product shot on plain background, cropped faces, cut-off heads, cut-off jewellery, out of frame, readable text, logos, giant rings, exaggerated proportions, floating overlays, cutouts, product diagrams, dark skin, deep brown skin, heavily tanned skin

hero.prompt:
Casting (required): fair-skinned Indian subjects only. Light wheatish to fair North Indian / urban Indian complexion. Do not use deep brown, dark, or heavily tanned skin.

Candid documentary lifestyle photograph, natural and unposed, real home photography, not a studio advertisement. Soft imperfect morning window light, gentle warm daylight, subtle uneven shadows, slight natural grain, realistic skin texture, lived-in Indian home interior with a simple sofa and ordinary household clutter softly out of focus in the background. Widescreen 16:9 landscape, full subjects visible, nothing cropped at edges.

International Men's Day 2026 warm everyday moment: a real father in a casual cotton t-shirt and open shirt embraces his young child at home, both smiling naturally, eyes half-closed from a genuine laugh. Intimate chest-up framing.

The father wears the exact gold curb-link chain from the reference images (@img1, @img2, @img3, @img4) the way a real man wears jewellery every day: the chain rests loosely and naturally around his neck and against his collarbone and shirt fabric, slightly nested into the fabric folds, with soft contact shadows under the links, muted warm metal reflections matching the room light, not overly shiny, not glowing, not floating, not oversized. The Tetyana Gold Chain must keep the exact link shape, pattern, thickness, and proportions from the references, true-to-life product scale relative to his neck, zero redesign.

This gold chain is the only jewellery in the image. Child wears plain clothes with no jewellery. No product overlays, cutouts, diagrams, logos, or text. Avoid CGI look, plastic skin, studio HDR glow, perfect catalogue lighting, floating jewellery, oversized chain, extra necklaces, rings, or bracelets. Photoreal candid family photo, jewellery looks worn and lived-in, not staged.
hero.alt: International Men's Day 2026 hero featuring The Tetyana Gold Chain
hero.revision: 2026-07-19 natural setting + everyday chain wear (v2 live; v3 alt saved)

flatlay.prompt: International Men's Day 2026 greeting card flatlay on a rich dark leather organizer, top-down view. On the right, a pen and a rolled-up note lie. At the centre, the identical gold band ring shown in the reference images (@img1, @img2, @img3, @img4) is in sharp focus. The Jasper Band For Him must be rendered at its actual, natural product scale with exact textured metal detailing and band width, zero distortion. A blank cream card is on the left with a faint handwritten Happy Men's Day note. Warm candlelight, realistic shallow depth of field. Keep the design of these jewelries accurate and do not change it's design. Add light, shadow and sufficient depth to the jewelleries. Jewelleries in focus. Hyperrealistic jewelry photography image. Position the jewelries naturally. Use dramatic lighting, contrast and shadow play to enhance depth. Do not change or crop the horizontal composition, fit it in the creative ratio. Avoid: floating overlays, graphic drawings, cutouts, product diagrams, extra floating jewelry, split screen, boxes, labels, oversized jewelry. • Do not distort or hallucinate the jewelries
